mapper.select: SELECT order_state AS orderState, COUNT(*) AS count FROM spu_order WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} and del_flag = 0 GROUP BY order_state ORDER BY order_state ASC
SELECT order_state AS orderState, COUNT(*) AS count FROM spu_order WHERE user_id = #{accountId} and del_flag = 0 GROUP BY order_state ORDER BY order_state ASC

select t.spu_id, t.id as spu_order_id, sum(t1.count) as order_count, sum(t1.refunding_count) as refunding_count, sum(t1.refunded_count) as refunded_count, sum(t1.delivery_count) as deliver_count, t.spu_name, t.spu_img, t.freight_amount from spu_order t left join sku_order t1 on t.id = t1.spu_order_id ${ew.customSqlSegment} group by t.id

select
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d-%h') as transDay,
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as transDay,
count(*) as transNum, sum(total_amount) as transAmount from spu_order where UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time) * 1000 between #{query.createBeginTime} and #{query.createEndTime} group by transDay order by transDay asc;
